caption: A dot block in a note, drawn as a diagram. The colors come from the dark theme.
eval: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['dot-diagrams']; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); P.pro.signOut(); document.body.classList.remove('theme-light'); document.body.classList.add('theme-dark'); app.workspace.trigger('css-change'); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const st = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...st, state: { ...st.state, mode: 'preview', source: false } }); await sleep(1500); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: every node of this map is a wikilink. Select a node to open its note.
eval: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['dot-diagrams']; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); P.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('dot-diagrams-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await P.pro.refreshNow(); document.body.classList.remove('theme-light'); document.body.classList.add('theme-dark'); app.workspace.trigger('css-change'); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const st = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...st, state: { ...st.state, mode: 'preview', source: false } }); await sleep(1500); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the exported SVG file in the vault, light on white, opened in Obsidian.
eval: (async () => { const P = app.plugins.plugins['dot-diagrams']; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); P.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('dot-diagrams-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await P.pro.refreshNow(); document.body.classList.remove('theme-light'); document.body.classList.add('theme-dark'); app.workspace.trigger('css-change'); const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const st = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...st, state: { ...st.state, mode: 'preview', source: false } }); await sleep(1500); const text = await app.vault.read(app.workspace.getActiveFile()); const m = /```dot\n([\s\S]*?)```/.exec(text); const path = await P.exportBlock(m[1], 'Architecture.md', 'svg'); await sleep(500); const f = app.vault.getFileByPath(path); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).openFile(f); await sleep(1200); return 'ok'; })()
